newsitem.title: USA: Southern to vote against United/Atmos merger.
newsitem.headline: Southern to vote against United/Atmos merger.

text.p: Southern Union Co said Friday it intends to vote all 854,300 common shares of stock held in United Cities Gas Co against the proposed merger with Atmos Energy Corp.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Southern Union said it intends to solicit proxies from other United shareholders to vote against the Atmos merger at a special shareholders meeting called by United on November 12.
Southern also said it plans to encourage other shareholders of United Cities to "assert their disssenters' rights," the filing said.
Southern also filed preliminary opposition proxy materials with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the filing said.
Southern Union holds a 6.5 percent stake in United Cities.
